ambient_events: The walkway takes a swell from the channel and passes it along, one section at a time, without a sound.
A pedestal at the root of an empty finger wakes, looks for a hull, finds none, and dims again.
The edge light brightens under your feet a step ahead of you and fades a step behind.
description: A floating walkway run out from the hardstanding gate, on pale composite sections that ride the water rather than stand in it, with no handrail because nothing about it needs one. A cool line of light is let into each edge. Three finger berths come off it for visitors, each with a chrome pedestal at the root that reads the hull's transponder before it will give up power or water. East, the walkway meets the fuel berth under its canopy.
name: Fairweather Marina — The Visitor Pontoon
